summary: All 10 online boxes were proven together in one SiN Gold deathmatch, re-verified at 18:12. The rcon status on the .123 listen server lists every box's IP. 9 boxes joined as Fleet<octet>; .243 joined as 'Blade'. 8 frames show the game rendering. The .186 frame is black (software renderer) and the .243 frame shows only the desktop (GDI cannot see the Voodoo 2); for those two, the roster is the proof. The game was closed on all boxes and PROCLIST shows no sin.exe anywhere.
issues: The .243 launcher does not pass +set name on the command line, so the box joins as SiN's default 'Blade' and lanparty's name match reports on_server='?'. The rcon address column confirms it is in the game.
Packets were not measured (packets=None): this is a peer title hosted on .123, so the dev host's tcpdump cannot see the traffic. The host's own rcon status is the witness.

sin.exe ignored the graceful WM_CLOSE on all 9 NT boxes. lanparty force-killed it after 12 s, and PROCKILL ended it on .243. Afterwards every box showed its desktop or agent console in the foreground, with no crash dialogs.
library_fix_needed: SiNGold .243 launcher (C:\FLEETMP 8.3 batch / lanparty_titles.json bats entry): add +set name Fleet243 on the command line, as the XP launchers do.
